author: KEXP
description: Go Kurosawa weaves together ambient, psych, and experimental textures to create his solo debut 'soft shakes.' In our latest Live on KEXP session, he shares a performance of "Moon, Please" and more.
title: Go Kurosawa "Moon, Please" & more Live on KEXP
